explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX or XXXXX=1 or XXXXX[1]

a:

you need the brackets 
XXXXX{1} 

or 
XXXXX(1) 

or 
XXXXX('') 

and then, after :
XXXXX = ''

a:

python syntax
XXXXX{1}

or 
XXXXX[1]

python dictionary syntax
dict = {'XXXXX': {'XXXXX1':1},':first': {'first1':'XXXXX'},'second':{'second':'second'},':third': {'third':'third'}}

dictionaries are unordered collections of key/value pairs.

a:

you can use the dictionary syntax to create a dictionary with the XXXXX value as string. i've defined first XXXXX with the first keyword and second XXXXX with the second keyword which you can use to set the XXXXX values.
{'first':'XXXXX','second':'second','third':'third'}
